---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or capability for Snap-it
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "discussion"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem Statement
What problem are you trying to solve? Is there something missing or difficult to do in the current experience?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature or workflow you would like to see. Be as specific as possible about the UI, camera interaction, or social workflow.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Why did they not work?

## Privacy & Architectural Considerations
- Does this feature preserve our zero-location invariant?
- Does it require changes to camera pipeline, Supabase schemas, or RLS policies?

## Visual Mockups or References
Attach sketches, wireframes, or reference UI patterns if available.
